title: Provider correctness: no Codex-only package members
prompt: Observe that Codex-only package members are absent from this Claude package.

expectations.summary: agents/openai.yaml is Codex metadata scoped by the authoring contract to Codex packages; the derivation record states no scripts/ helper was authored. Both must actually be absent.

title: Authored eval inputs are present in the source package
prompt: Observe that the authored eval inputs and every fixture named by evals.json exist in the source tree.

expectations.summary: evals/ belongs in the authored source (and is stripped from installed copies). Each file listed in an evals.json case must actually be stageable.

title: The shipped handoff template hard-codes the honest status lines
prompt: Observe whether the handoff template the workflow routes to carries populated Validation and Behavioural status fields rather than placeholders.

expectations.summary: SKILL-007's PreparedTransfer exit and SKILL.md section 5 require the transfer to state Validation status: Not performed and behavioural status NOT_EVALUATED. If the template left these as fill-in fields an author could quietly omit them.

title: Copied governing templates are byte-identical to their docs/mvp sources
prompt: Observe whether the three assets the derivation record calls byte-identical copies still hash to their governing template digests.

expectations.summary: derivation.json claims transformation: none for expert-spec.md, expert-package.md and expert-skill.md. The expected digests are the docs/mvp template digests observed at P1 freeze, supplied here as declared sentinels.

title: The entrypoint carries no repository path, developer home path or Codex invocation form
prompt: Scan SKILL.md for strings that would make the installed skill depend on this repository or on another provider.

expectations.summary: The authoring contract forbids an installed skill depending on docs/mvp or a developer home directory; the Claude package must not carry the Codex $skill invocation form or .agents/skills paths.

title: Derivation destination digests versus the actual package bytes
prompt: Establish whether every destination_sha256 in references/derivation.json still matches the file it names.

expectations.summary: derivation.json states that a destination digest no longer matching the package file is drift. No shipped grader compares a JSON-embedded digest map against a tree, so this is routed to manual inspection rather than silently skipped.

assertions.routed_to: manual structural observation, method INSPECTION_MANUAL; see verification-results.md section S-04
assertions.notes: Recorded as INDETERMINATE deliberately: the runner cannot establish this and must not appear to have done so.

title: Installed-copy observations

expectations.summary: No installed copy of this candidate exists in this assignment, so every installed-mode observation is unavailable here.
